Package neqsim.process.engineering

Class CompressorAutomationWorkflow

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.CompressorAutomationWorkflow
public final class CompressorAutomationWorkflow extends Object
Runs the public compressor model, canonical instrumentation, native acceptance cases and professional export.

This is a thin composition of existing engineering APIs. It does not implement another transient solver or verdict engine. The synthetic map, installed independence, machinery-protection data, normative drawing approval and safety qualification remain explicit engineering review tasks. Unsupported canonical safety-policy edits fail readback.

1.0

    • run

      public static Map<String,Object> run(CompressorAutomationStudy.Design design, PidDesignModel canonicalProposal, List<CompressorAutomationStudy.CaseDefinition> definitions, Path directory) throws IOException
      Executes an optional revised canonical proposal and an explicit native acceptance selection.

      Canonical control settings are applied to an isolated healthy train before fault construction. Fault receipts are frozen from declared overrides; the runtime observer only verifies readback and never erases faults. The existing coordinated strict engineering runner owns case execution and its typed results.

      Parameters:
      design - design assumptions copied before use
      canonicalProposal - optional edited canonical graph, or null to import actual native objects
      definitions - explicit case definitions; the output records whether the selection is a subset
      directory - new output directory, never overwritten
      Returns:
      detached status map
      Throws:
      IOException - if artifact publication fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if input, canonical policy, fault scope or output identity is invalid
